fields.role: The job title or function of the personnel.
fields.operational_phase: The current stage of plant operation.
fields.authorization: The level of access or permission granted.

fields.parameter_tag: The unique identifier for a process stream or instrument.
fields.measurement: The name of the property being measured.
fields.metric_unit: The unit of measure for the parameter.
fields.min_bound: The lower limit of an acceptable range.
fields.max_bound: The upper limit of an acceptable range.
fields.required_correction: The action to be taken when a parameter is out of bounds.
fields.time_allowance: The duration permitted to resolve an issue or perform a task.
fields.subject: The specific component or parameter being targeted.
fields.low_tier_alert: The threshold for a low-level warning.
fields.critical_low_trip: The threshold for a critical low-level shutdown.

fields.critical_high_trip: The threshold for a critical high-level shutdown.
fields.maintenance_philosophy: The overarching strategy for equipment maintenance.
fields.regulatory_compliance: Legal or regulatory mandates for the operation.
fields.operational_troubleshooting_and_diagnost: Procedures for diagnosing and fixing operational issues.
